rule: Every class runs seeds 1 to 32 defended, plus one run per control and per defence-in-depth check. Defended: every own counter and every zero-tolerance counter is 0 and every scheduled event is delivered, reaches its component and engages it, in every seed; the ratio bounds hold over the 32 seeds (nearest rank, k = (p x 32 + 99) // 100). A control fires its own counter through its event in all 32 seeds (Q-MAS1-REV2). A defence-in-depth check keeps the class's violation counters at 0 with its remaining defence engaged, in every seed. A class is PASS only when every gate holds. A PASS does not satisfy topology-coordination's 'denied until MAS-RA-010 passes' (Q-M4-10 (a)). A multi-event control fires its own counter through its countEvent, with every bypassed check on a row tagged with one of its events. C5's measurements (the runs of its OBJECTIVE-OFF control) are reported and not gated: a PASS or FAIL there neither lifts nor upholds the denial. CONF-MAS-003: a depth check that names an event counts engagement only over rows tagged with that event; C8's and C9's measurements and the MAS1-CARRY-1 arms (top-level arms) are reported and not gated, and packet 1's baseline policy stays the gated one. CONF-MAS-004: C11 and C12 are gated like every class; the scaling section gates safety only and reports its readings and the baseline comparison; the hard-coding section gates its four results. CONF-MAS-005: C13 is gated like every class; the over-revision section reports its readings and gates nothing.
